verdict.rationale: llama.cpp's own README documents CPU+GPU hybrid inference for running models larger than total VRAM. Community reports corroborate this: users describe splitting models across GPU and CPU to run 70B models on a desktop, and tuning offload with N_GPU_LAYERS. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the offload controls (e.g., layer-offload flags and tuning guidance) in the evidence, plus concrete performance figures for hybrid offload.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload

citations.quote: CPU+GPU hybrid inference to partially accelerate models larger than the total VRAM capacity
model splitting across GPU/CPU lets users run 70B models on desktop or 33B on a 16GB RAM laptop that otherwise couldn't run them
seemed limited to a max of 40 N_GPU_LAYERS before updating
